name: 89107 · Las Vegas, NV
findings: ZIP 89107 (Las Vegas) has 154 nonprofit organizations. 50 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 44 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89107 (Las Vegas) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 89107 (Las Vegas) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 44 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.
